_about: Perk names and one-line descriptions. name <=12 chars, desc <=80 chars. Rules in levels/actions.json progression.perks.

screen.title: Choose a gift
screen.sub: {hero} has grown. Pick one. It's for keeps.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.desc: His shield covers both front heroes. Stand close.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Axe hits splash half damage onto a second monster.

stubborn.name: Stubborn
stubborn.desc: Once per fight, a killing blow leaves him at 1 HP. Too rude to die.

heavy_swing.name: Heavy Swing
heavy_swing.desc: Axe hits +3 damage, but he's half a second slower.

quick_hands.name: Quick Hands
quick_hands.desc: Dagger ready in 1.5 s instead of 2.

dirty_tricks.name: Dirty Tricks
dirty_tricks.desc: Pocket sand stops a wind-up, and it's ready sooner.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.desc: Dagger crits on 18-20. She knows where it hurts.

light_fingers.name: Light Fingers
light_fingers.desc: Once per floor, opens a lock with no key. Chests give 1 more potion.

mercy.name: Mercy
mercy.desc: Her heal also lifts a downed hero back up.

steady_flame.name: Steady Flame
steady_flame.desc: Every second torch she relights costs no oil.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.desc: Heal the two most hurt heroes at once. 6 mana.

ember_ward.name: Ember Ward
ember_ward.desc: Her ember lights a full extra square. Leeches won't touch her.

deep_frost.name: Deep Frost
deep_frost.desc: Frost bolt slows its target. Its next attack comes 1.5 s late.

tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
tidecaller.desc: +2 wand damage to anything standing in water. The swamp remembers.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.desc: Frost bolt crits on 17-20 and goes straight through slime.

cold_blood.name: Cold Blood
cold_blood.desc: Mana comes back every 6 steps, not 10. Scales have perks.
